# NEXUS CORE

> Free AI-built gold (XAUUSD) game plan: key zones, scenarios and the level that proves the view wrong, refreshed before the Asia, London and New York sessions, every plan graded in public.

NEXUS CORE AI publishes a free, AI-built trading plan for gold (XAUUSD) three times each trading day: before the Asia session (07:00 GMT+7), before London (13:45 GMT+7) and before New York (19:30 GMT+7). Each plan gives the bias, the main zone, targets, the level that invalidates the view, scenarios with rough probabilities, and the economic calendar. Every plan is graded in public on 15-minute candles after it expires: wins, losses and misses all stay on the record. Analysis only, not financial advice.

## Latest plan (2026-11-26, Pre-London update, updated 2026-11-26 13:49 GMT+7)

- Permanent page: https://nexuscore.trade/en/plan/2026-11-26-london/
- Bias: TWO-WAY
- Summary: Two-way 3551⁠–⁠3607 on US holiday; lower edge 3551⁠–⁠3567.7; The view is wrong on M15 close below 3550
- Main zone: BUY 3551–3567.7
- Target T1: 3590

- Target T3: 3627.7
- Target T4: 3637.9
- Target T5: 3646.8
- Target T6: 3678.5
- Target T7: 3551.3
- Target T8: 3540.5
- Target T9: 3503
- Target T10: 3426.8
- Expected range: 3551–3607
- View is wrong if: Lower edge 3551⁠–⁠3567.7: an M15 close below 3550 with no recovery on the next candle → off, down to 3540.5 / 3503. Upper edge 3590⁠–⁠3607: an M15 close above 3608 that holds on the next candle → off, up to 3627.7 / 3637.9.
- Main scenario (~60%, BUY): Main: the 3551⁠–⁠3607 range continues, a test of the 3551⁠–⁠3567.7 lower edge, then a bounce back to 3580⁠–⁠3590.
- Alternate scenario (~40%, SELL): Alternate: an M15 close below 3550 (the H4 bounce fails) → down to 3540.5 then 3503, thin liquidity may stretch it into the Asia session; a break above 3608 is unlikely on the holiday.
